hero.headline: Beautiful nails, done right in El Sobrante
hero.sub: From a clean classic set to full custom art, Precious Nails takes the time to get it right.

story.title: Welcome to Precious Nails
body: Precious Nails is a full-service nail studio in El Sobrante, where a licensed team handles everything from a clean classic manicure to sculpted extensions and custom art.

Every service starts with properly sterilized tools and a fresh file. We take the time to prep the nail correctly, because that is the difference between a set that lasts a weekend and one that lasts for weeks.
We are open 6 days a week, and walk-ins are always welcome — though a quick call to (510) 758-9025 guarantees your spot.

why.title: Genuinely warm service
why.body: You get greeted by name, not processed through a queue. Our regulars stay regulars for a reason.

why.title: Spotless and sanitized
why.body: Fresh files, liners, and fully sterilized tools for every single guest — no exceptions.

why.title: Meticulous attention
why.body: Even cuticles, clean lines, and shaping that gets checked twice before you leave the chair.

why.title: Work that actually lasts
why.body: Proper prep and quality product mean gel and dip that hold up for weeks, not days.

why.title: A real spa experience
why.body: Massage chairs, a calm room, and time that never feels rushed — treatment, not transaction.

why.title: Custom nail art on request
why.body: Bring a screenshot or an idea. Our techs design freehand and match what you had in mind.

photos.alt: A manicure in progress at the salon table

reviews.author: Geanette Ceballos
reviews.text: Welcoming staff and a thorough pedicure. Very clean foot baths, and the nail tech followed up to sanitize tools with alcohol and did more cleaning between clients. New liners were used. My feet feel great!

reviews.author: Ashley Kumar
reviews.text: The service provided here was quite nice and the nail techs were very gentle with me. I was happy with my end results.

reviews.author: Victoria Purdy
reviews.text: Close to home! Tina did my nails today, and they were able to accommodate me as a walk-in on a Saturday. Lucky for me!
